criteria.intent: Explicit formatter scope, configuration and pinning.
criteria.automated_scope: Preparation only: the bounded guard proves its current ownership/CSS/literal-import subset. Actual formatter inventory, pinning and coverage negatives are not implemented; add deterministic R2 checks before claiming this criterion.

criteria.intent: Mechanical formatting, idempotence and semantic preservation.
criteria.automated_scope: Preparation only: Basic proves existing generated/script/route/geometry/size/runtime invariants. Format check, second-write idempotence and JS/Python/HTML/CSS equivalence checks are missing and must be implemented/mapped.

criteria.intent: Actual source quality checks run in CI.
criteria.automated_scope: Preparation only: no formatter CI or new drift/lint-coverage implementation exists. Actual formatter/lint reports and meaningful coverage/drift tests must be implemented/mapped; baseline green CI is not completion.

Preparation only: Basic proves current generation/Color-export syntax/route/geometry/budget invariants. Permanent serialization/semantic/incremental/offline checks and current-head hosted/layout evidence must be mapped and executed for the formatted candidate.

criteria.intent: Exact scanner debt and public fingerprint rebinding.
criteria.automated_scope: Preparation only: no scanner disposition is changed. Actual lint/security scans and semantic-equivalent exact fingerprint refresh are not proved by this policy; current candidate reports and independent proof remain blocking.

Current guard, catalog/RI freshness and RI/CI checks prove existing bounded repository invariants, not all CS judgments or future formatter/profile coverage. Review unautomated rules and run complete candidate checks.

criteria.intent: Separate reviewed delivery, merge and post-merge checks.
criteria.automated_scope: Current RI/CI routes support source-bound checks, but this runner cannot observe implementation completion, Draft linkage, review/CI/checkbox mutation, maintainer authorization or merged-main checks. All required gates remain pending.

IMPLEMENTATION.description: Blocking preparation state: R2 is not implemented. Actual deterministic formatter inventory/pinning/check/second-write/drift, coverage and semantic/serialization/output checks are missing. Expand this preliminary policy to real named checks and run them at the exact R2 candidate before any whole-AC checkbox. Baseline passing checks cannot resolve this gate or claim R2 completion.

INDEPENDENT.description: Independently review the complete implementation diff, CS applicability, JS/Python/HTML/CSS semantics, serialized factories and exact complexity/Bandit/public fingerprint rebinding. Planning review is distinct from future code review; record exact reviewer/source findings.

LIVE.description: Verify actual current-head formatter/lint/security/CI reports, complete source coverage, hosted/layout evidence, source/tree/artifact identity and actual checkbox/PR linkage. Preliminary baseline or older R1 reports do not satisfy R2.

MERGED.description: After a separate maintainer decision, record actual merged R2 commit/tree and post-merge checks, reconcile child59/parent58. This preparation does not authorize merge, stable staging/promotion or production.
